# Engine-job texts

What the user reads about engine jobs, saves and recovery, rendered from the code that says it, with placeholders in angle brackets. `design/specs/engine-jobs.md` §11 says when each text shows, with its actions and code, and cites it by its key. To change a text, change the code and regenerate this file.

## Jobs (`app.platform.engine_jobs.text`)

| Key | Where it shows | Text |
|---|---|---|
| `msg:phase.starting` | a job's phase, at once (§5.4) | Starting the ledger engine… |
| `msg:phase.reading` | a job's phase, at once (§5.4) | Reading your ledger… |
| `msg:phase.checking_change` | a job's phase, at once (§5.4) | Checking your change… |
| `msg:phase.saving` | a job's phase, at once (§5.4) | Saving… |
| `msg:phase.updating_views` | a job's phase, at once (§5.4) | Updating your views… |
| `msg:phase.working` | a job on its engine before its first phase | Working… |
| `msg:waiting_for` | a queued job (§5.4) | Waiting for: <the running job's phase> |
| `msg:still_working` | after the display delay (§5.4) | Still working… |
| `msg:finishing` | a writing job past its commit point (§4) | Finishing your change… |
| `msg:advice` | a signalled process not ended, or the engine lock waited for (§5.2) | Finzytrack cannot stop the earlier ledger work. Quit and reopen Finzytrack. |
| `msg:cancelled` | a Cancel (§4) | Cancelled. |
| `msg:cannot_stop_from_here` | a Cancel behind work the user cannot end (§4) | Your request is cancelled. The earlier ledger work cannot be stopped from here; if it never finishes, quit and reopen Finzytrack. |
| `msg:unavailable.stopped_often` | `ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE {stopped_often}` | The ledger engine stopped several times. Your ledger files are safe. Saving is off until it works again. |
| `msg:unavailable.cannot_start` | `ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE {cannot_start}` | The ledger engine could not start. You can still look at your ledgers; saving changes is off. |
| `msg:unavailable.incompatible` | `ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE {incompatible}` | This installation is damaged. Please reinstall Finzytrack. |
| `msg:unavailable.closing` | `ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE {closing}` | Finzytrack is closing. |

## Saves (`app.platform.engine_jobs.save_text`)

| Key | Where it shows | Text |
|---|---|---|
| `msg:save.unchanged` | not saved; every target hashed again equals its pre bytes | Your change was not saved. Your ledger is unchanged. |
| `msg:save.changed_by_other` | not saved after an engine death; a target is not at its pre bytes (§6.6) | Your change was not saved, and <file> was changed by another program. |
| `msg:save.not_checked` | not saved; the re-hash could not be done | Your change was not saved. Finzytrack could not check whether your ledger changed. |
| `msg:save.io_error` | `CHANGE_NOT_SAVED {io_error}` naming the file the error happened at (S0100); then the re-hash's sentence | Your change was not saved. Finzytrack could not read or write <file>. Your ledger is unchanged. |
| `msg:save.read_back` | `CHANGE_NOT_SAVED {read_back}` (S0100); then the re-hash's sentence | Your change was not saved. <file> did not read back as Finzytrack wrote it. Your ledger is unchanged. |
| `msg:save.name_not_utf8` | `CHANGE_NOT_SAVED {name_not_utf8}` (S0100); then the re-hash's sentence | Your change was not saved. The name of <file> is not valid text (UTF-8), so Finzytrack cannot record it. Your ledger is unchanged. |
| `msg:save.rehash_changed` | the re-hash's sentence when it found a file not at its pre bytes (S0100, BL-0163 (b)); here after `io_error` | Your change was not saved. Finzytrack could not read or write <file>. <other file> was changed by another program. |
| `msg:save.rehash_not_checked` | the re-hash's sentence when it could not read a file and found none changed; here after `io_error` | Your change was not saved. Finzytrack could not read or write <file>. Finzytrack could not check whether your ledger changed. |
| `msg:save.case_twins` | `CHANGE_NOT_SAVED {case_twins}`: two files whose names differ only in case (S0100, BL-0162) | Finzytrack did not save your change. <file> and another file in this change have names this drive may treat as the same (for example, they differ only in capital letters). Finzytrack cannot save both in one change. Rename one of them, then try again. Your ledger is unchanged. |
| `msg:save.folder_appeared` | `CHANGE_NOT_SAVED {folder_appeared}`: a folder stood where the save makes one (S0100, BL-0187) | Finzytrack did not save your change. A folder <folder> appeared where Finzytrack was about to make one. Try again. Your ledger is unchanged. |
| `msg:save.app_folder_missing` | `CHANGE_NOT_SAVED {app_folder_missing}`: the app's own folder is gone (S0100, BL-0163 (a)) | Finzytrack did not save your change. Its data folder <folder> is missing. Quit Finzytrack and open it again, then try again. Your ledger is unchanged. |
| `msg:save.ledger_changed` | `LEDGER_EXTERNALLY_CHANGED` | Your ledger changed after this preview, so Finzytrack did not save your change. Review it again. |
| `msg:save.hard_linked` | `CHANGE_NOT_SAVED {hard_linked}` | Finzytrack did not save your change. <file> has a second name on disk (a hard link). Remove the extra link, or replace the file with a copy, then try again. |
| `msg:save.locked` | `CHANGE_NOT_SAVED {locked}` | Finzytrack did not save your change. <file> is locked. Unlock it (Finder: Get Info), then try again. |
| `msg:save.no_drive_id` | `CHANGE_NOT_SAVED {no_drive_id}` (S0089) | Finzytrack did not save your change. Finzytrack cannot identify the drive that holds <file>, so it could not undo the change if saving were interrupted. Keep your ledger on a drive Finzytrack can identify, such as your Mac's own disk or a USB drive. |
| `msg:save.no_folder_id` | `CHANGE_NOT_SAVED {no_folder_id}` (S0089) | Finzytrack did not save your change. The folder that holds <file> has no creation time that Finzytrack can read, so Finzytrack cannot tell it from a folder at the same place on another drive. It could not undo the change safely if saving were interrupted. If <file> is at the top level of a USB drive, make a folder on the drive, move your ledger into it, and open it from there. Otherwise keep your ledger on another drive, such as your Mac's own disk. |
| `msg:save.not_a_file` | `CHANGE_NOT_SAVED {not_a_file}` | Finzytrack did not save your change. <file> is not a normal file. |
| `msg:save.permission` | `CHANGE_NOT_SAVED {permission}` | Finzytrack did not save your change. Your Mac does not allow changes to <file>. Check its permissions (Finder: Get Info), then try again. |
| `msg:save.permission_acl` | `CHANGE_NOT_SAVED {permission}` with a folder and its ACL entry | Finzytrack did not save your change. The folder <folder> has a permission entry (ACL) that stops Finzytrack from saving safely: <entry>. Remove that entry, then try again. |
| `msg:save.permission_folder` | `CHANGE_NOT_SAVED {permission}` at the app's journal or backups folder, no ACL entry known | Finzytrack did not save your change. Your Mac does not allow changes to <folder>. Check its permissions (Finder: Get Info), then try again. |
| `msg:save.permission_unknown` | `CHANGE_NOT_SAVED {permission}` with neither file nor folder known | Finzytrack did not save your change. Your Mac does not allow changes to your ledger. Check its permissions (Finder: Get Info), then try again. |
| `msg:save.linked_folder_unknown` | `CHANGE_NOT_SAVED {linked_folder}` with no folder known | Finzytrack did not save your change. The folder of its save records is a link to another place. Finzytrack keeps its save records and backups only in a real folder. Put the real folder back in its place, or remove the link, then try again. |
| `msg:save.unnamed_file` | any save text above whose file is not known names it this way (here `locked`) | Finzytrack did not save your change. A ledger file is locked. Unlock it (Finder: Get Info), then try again. |
| `msg:save.linked_folder` | `CHANGE_NOT_SAVED {linked_folder}` | Finzytrack did not save your change. The folder <folder> is a link to another place. Finzytrack keeps its save records and backups only in a real folder. Put the real folder back in its place, or remove the link, then try again. |
| `msg:save.reopen` | `WRITES_PAUSED {unfinished_save}` | Finzytrack could not finish your change. Reopen the workspace so Finzytrack can check your files and undo the unfinished change. |
| `msg:save.reopen_after_created` | `WRITES_PAUSED {unfinished_save, file}`: the undo stopped at a file the save was creating | Finzytrack could not finish your change. Reopen the workspace so Finzytrack can check your files. It will ask you about <file>, which it was creating. |
| `msg:save.earlier_unfinished` | `WRITES_PAUSED {earlier_unfinished}`: refused at step 1 or 4, an earlier save is unfinished (S0100, BL-0183) | Your change was not saved. An earlier change is not finished. Reopen the workspace so Finzytrack can check your files and undo the unfinished change, then try again. |
| `msg:save.best_effort_drive` | the open of a workspace on a drive without the swap (§6.8) | This drive (for example a USB stick or network share) can't replace files in one safe step. Finzytrack still keeps a backup of every save, but if another program edits the same file at the very moment you save, its change can be lost. For full protection, keep your ledger on your computer's own disk. |

## Recovery (`app.platform.engine_jobs.recovery_text`)

Each blocked screen's actions are `Screen.actions` (§11).

| Key | Where it shows | Text |
|---|---|---|
| `msg:recovery.undone` | notice after recover-all undid a save | Finzytrack undid an interrupted save in <workspace>. |
| `msg:recovery.kept_copy_undoing` | `stopped`, a kept copy this try made | Another program changed <file> while Finzytrack was undoing an unfinished change in <workspace>. Finzytrack kept the other program's version as <kept copy>. Compare the two files. To undo Finzytrack's unfinished change, delete the kept copy and press Retry. To keep the files as they are now, choose Keep the files as they are now, then delete or move the kept copy before you use the ledger. |
| `msg:recovery.kept_copy_found` | `stopped`, a kept copy the try found when it started | Another program changed <file> while Finzytrack was saving or undoing a change in <workspace>. Finzytrack kept the other program's version as <kept copy>. Compare the two files. To undo Finzytrack's unfinished change, delete the kept copy and press Retry. To keep the files as they are now, choose Keep the files as they are now, then delete or move the kept copy before you use the ledger. |
| `msg:recovery.kept_copy_unnamed` | `stopped`, a kept copy that cannot be named | Another program changed <file> while Finzytrack was saving or undoing a change in <workspace>. Finzytrack kept the other program's version as a file next to <file> whose name contains .kept-. Compare the two files. To undo Finzytrack's unfinished change, delete the kept copy and press Retry. To keep the files as they are now, choose Keep the files as they are now, then delete or move the kept copy before you use the ledger. |
| `msg:recovery.created` | `stopped`, `created_path_taken` | Finzytrack was creating <file> when the save was interrupted. It cannot tell whether this file holds that unfinished change or another program's file, so it left it alone. Look at it; if you don't want it, delete it and press Retry, or choose Keep the files as they are now. |
| `msg:recovery.permission_acl` | `stopped`, `permission`, a folder's ACL entry | Finzytrack could not undo an unfinished save in <workspace>. The folder <folder> has a permission entry (ACL) that stops Finzytrack from saving safely: <entry>. Remove that entry, then press Retry. |
| `msg:recovery.permission` | `stopped`, `permission`, no entry known | Finzytrack could not undo an unfinished save in <workspace>. Your Mac does not allow Finzytrack to change <path>/<file>. If it has a permission entry (ACL), remove it (Terminal: chmod -N "<path>/<file>"), then press Retry. |
| `msg:recovery.wrong_drive` | `stopped`, `wrong_drive` (S0089) | Finzytrack could not undo an unfinished save in <workspace>. The folder <folder> is not the one Finzytrack saved <file> in: it is on another drive, or the folder was made again or changed since. If the drive that held your ledger is not plugged in, plug it in, then press Retry. Otherwise choose Keep the files as they are now. |
| `msg:recovery.missing_unconfirmed` | `stopped`, `missing_unconfirmed` (S0089 round 2) | Finzytrack could not undo an unfinished save in <workspace>. <file> is missing on the drive at <path>, and nothing else on that drive shows that it is the drive that held your ledger, so Finzytrack did not put the file back. If it is that drive, copy <backup file> (the old version Finzytrack kept) to <path>/<file>, then press Retry. Otherwise plug in the drive that held your ledger, then press Retry, or choose Keep the files as they are now. |

| `msg:recovery.drive_backup` | added to a `wrong_drive` or `unknown_drive` stop, per replaced file behind that drive with its backup checked good (S0090) | If <file> is missing from its folder, its old version is in <backup file>. ## Creates (`app.platform.engine_jobs.create_text`)

| Key | Where it shows | Text |
|---|---|---|
| `msg:create.not_empty` | create onto a folder that is not empty (§8.2 step 1) | This folder is not empty. Choose an empty folder or a new name. |
| `msg:create.not_a_folder` | a file stands at the target | Not created. <folder> is a file, not a folder. Choose an empty folder or a new name. |
| `msg:create.no_parent` | the folder the target goes in does not exist | Not created. The folder to put <folder> in does not exist. |
| `msg:create.permission` | the system will not let Finzytrack write in the folder | Not created. The system does not let Finzytrack write in <folder>. |
| `msg:create.taken` | a name the job writes was taken meanwhile (§8.2 step 3) | Not created. Another program put <file> into the folder at the same moment. |
| `msg:create.read_back` | a file is not what the job wrote (§8.2 step 4) | Not created. Another program changed <file> while Finzytrack was writing it. |
| `msg:create.load_failed` | the load check could not run (§8.2 step 5) | Not created. Finzytrack could not check the new ledger. |
| `msg:create.load_errors` | the new ledger loads with errors | Not created. The new ledger has errors. This is a fault in Finzytrack; please report it. |
| `msg:create.load_outside` | the new ledger reads a file outside its folder | Not created. The new ledger reads a file outside its folder (<path>/<file>). This is a fault in Finzytrack; please report it. |
| `msg:create.path_moved` | the folder moved during the writes | Not created. The folder was moved or renamed while Finzytrack was writing it. |
| `msg:create.io_error` | an error the system answered (here `EIO`) | Not created. Finzytrack could not write <file>. The system answered: <system's answer>. |
| `msg:create.stopped` | the engine stopped before its answer | Not created. Finzytrack stopped before it finished. |
| `msg:create.manifest_taken` | a `.finzytrack` another program put there at step 7 | Not created. Another program put a Finzytrack workspace file into <folder> at the same moment. Check the folder before you use it. |
| `msg:create.left` | added when the job kept entries it could not be sure are only its own (here two) | Not created. Another program put <file> into the folder at the same moment. Finzytrack left these in <folder> because it could not be sure they are only its own: <name>, <other name>. Check them, and remove any you do not need. |
| `msg:create.left_many` | the same with more than five: the first five, then how many more | Not created. Another program put <file> into the folder at the same moment. Finzytrack left these in <folder> because it could not be sure they are only its own: <name 1>, <name 2>, <name 3>, <name 4>, <name 5> and 3 more. Check them, and remove any you do not need. |
| `msg:create.left_folder` | added when a stopped job kept only the folder it made (another program's entry is in it, or its identity could not be read) | Not created. The new ledger has errors. This is a fault in Finzytrack; please report it. Finzytrack left the folder <folder> because it could not be sure everything in it is its own. Check it, and remove it if you do not need it. |
| `msg:create.maybe_made_folder` | added after an engine death when the read finds nothing at the job's names in the folder (the job may not have made it) | Not created. Finzytrack stopped before it finished. Finzytrack may have made the folder <folder>. Check it, and remove it if you do not need it. |
| `msg:create.unfinished_unlisted` | added when the folder was not cleaned up or listed (no engine, an error) | Not created. Finzytrack stopped before it finished. The folder <folder> may hold an unfinished new workspace. Check it before you delete anything. |
| `msg:create.cancelled` | a create the user cancelled after it started (its engine ended: no listing) | Not created. The folder <folder> may hold an unfinished new workspace. Check it before you delete anything. |

## Copies (`app.platform.engine_jobs.copy_text`)

| Key | Where it shows | Text |
|---|---|---|
| `msg:copy.not_empty` | copy onto a folder that is not empty (§8.2 step 1, the create's) | This folder is not empty. Choose an empty folder or a new name. |
| `msg:copy.not_a_folder` | a file stands at the target | Not copied. <folder> is a file, not a folder. Choose an empty folder or a new name. |
| `msg:copy.no_parent` | the folder the target goes in does not exist | Not copied. The folder to put <folder> in does not exist. |
| `msg:copy.permission` | the system will not let Finzytrack write in the folder | Not copied. The system does not let Finzytrack write in <folder>. |
| `msg:copy.legacy_saving` | an old Finzytrack app's write lock is held, could not be tried, or appeared during the copy (ADR-0062) | Not copied. The old Finzytrack app is saving. Quit the old Finzytrack first, then try again. |
| `msg:copy.recovery_blocked` | an `.open` journal names a source file (§8.1, INV-32) | Not copied. A save to <file> did not finish, and Finzytrack has not undone it yet. Restart Finzytrack so it can finish it, then try again. |
| `msg:copy.recovery_unreadable` | an `.open` journal or a journal folder could not be read | Not copied. Finzytrack could not read its record of an unfinished save. Restart Finzytrack, then try again. |
| `msg:copy.source_missing` | the source's root does not exist | Not copied. <file> does not exist. |
| `msg:copy.source_unreadable` | a source file could not be read (here `EIO`) | Not copied. Finzytrack could not read <file>. The system answered: <system's answer>. |
| `msg:copy.source_failed` | the source's load could not run | Not copied. Finzytrack could not load your ledger. |
| `msg:copy.number_failed` | Beancount's arithmetic failed on a number of the source, line known (S0098) | Not copied. Beancount cannot compute an amount of the transaction on line 12 of <file>, and bean-check fails there too. Check its numbers: one with more than 28 digits, or a quantity of 0 with a total price or cost. Writing every amount of the transaction can help. |
| `msg:copy.beancount_failed` | Beancount's own load raised on the source, no line known (S0098) | Not copied. Beancount cannot load your ledger (<file>). bean-check fails on it too. A plugin of the ledger may have made an entry Beancount cannot check. |
| `msg:copy.encrypted` | the source holds an encrypted ledger file (ADR-0059) | Not copied. <file> is encrypted. This version of Finzytrack does not read encrypted ledger files. |
| `msg:copy.source_changed` | a source changed while it was copied, or before the commit point (the owner's words) | Not copied. Your ledger changed while Finzytrack was copying it. Try again. |
| `msg:copy.cannot_rewrite` | a line naming another file could not be pointed at the copy (here at line 7) | Not copied. Finzytrack could not change a line that names another file in <file> (line 7). |
| `msg:copy.cannot_place_reserved` | the source uses a folder named `.finzytrack` | Not copied. Your ledger uses a folder named .finzytrack (<file>), a name Finzytrack keeps for itself. |
| `msg:copy.cannot_place_documents` | the new folder is inside one of the source's documents roots | Not copied. The new folder is inside your ledger's documents folder. Choose another place. |
| `msg:copy.cannot_place_legacy` | the new folder is inside the old app's folder (the legacy root of a lock the request names; INV-26) | Not copied. The new folder is inside the old Finzytrack app's folder. Choose another place. |
| `msg:copy.cannot_place` | two source files would take one name in the copy | Not copied. <file> and another of your files would get the same name in the new folder. |
| `msg:copy.cannot_place_target` | the ledger names a path inside the new folder | Not copied. Your ledger names a file inside the new folder (<path>/<file>). Choose another place. |
| `msg:copy.cannot_place_fault` | the writer's own check of the copy's plan refused it (a Finzytrack fault) | Not copied. Finzytrack could not place the files of the copy. This is a fault in Finzytrack; please report it. |
| `msg:copy.plugin_modules` | the copy does not load the same, and the source names a plugin that is not Beancount's own (BL-0202) | Not copied. The copy did not load the same as your ledger, which uses a plugin of its own (<plugin>). This version of Finzytrack cannot copy a ledger's own plugins. |
| `msg:copy.load_differs` | the copy does not load the same as the source (here first at an entry's line 12) | Not copied. The copy did not load the same as your ledger (first at <file>, line 12). |
| `msg:copy.load_differs_errors` | the same, when only Beancount's errors differ (`options`: "its options differ") | Not copied. The copy did not load the same as your ledger (its Beancount errors differ). |
| `msg:copy.load_failed` | the copy's load could not run | Not copied. Finzytrack could not check the copy. |
| `msg:copy.load_outside` | the copy reads a file outside its folder | Not copied. The copy reads a file outside its folder (<path>/<file>). This is a fault in Finzytrack; please report it. |
| `msg:copy.taken` | a name the job writes was taken meanwhile | Not copied. Another program put <file> into the folder at the same moment. |
| `msg:copy.read_back` | a file is not what the job wrote | Not copied. Another program changed <file> while Finzytrack was writing it. |
| `msg:copy.path_moved` | the folder moved during the writes | Not copied. The folder was moved or renamed while Finzytrack was writing it. |
| `msg:copy.io_error` | an error the system answered (here `EIO`) | Not copied. Finzytrack could not write <file>. The system answered: <system's answer>. |
| `msg:copy.stopped` | the engine stopped before its answer | Not copied. Finzytrack stopped before it finished. |
| `msg:copy.manifest_taken` | a `.finzytrack` another program put there at step 7 | Not copied. Another program put a Finzytrack workspace file into <folder> at the same moment. Check the folder before you use it. |
| `msg:copy.left` | added when the job kept entries it could not be sure are only its own (`msg:create.left`'s words) | Not copied. Another program put <file> into the folder at the same moment. Finzytrack left these in <folder> because it could not be sure they are only its own: <name>, <other name>. Check them, and remove any you do not need. |
| `msg:copy.left_folder` | added when a stopped job kept only the folder it made (`msg:create.left_folder`'s words) | Not copied. Finzytrack could not check the copy. Finzytrack left the folder <folder> because it could not be sure everything in it is its own. Check it, and remove it if you do not need it. |
| `msg:copy.maybe_made_folder` | added after an engine death when the read finds the folder empty (`msg:create.maybe_made_folder`'s words) | Not copied. Finzytrack stopped before it finished. Finzytrack may have made the folder <folder>. Check it, and remove it if you do not need it. |
| `msg:copy.unfinished_unlisted` | added when the folder was not cleaned up or listed (no engine, an error) | Not copied. Finzytrack stopped before it finished. The folder <folder> may hold an unfinished copy. Check it before you delete anything. |
| `msg:copy.cancelled` | a copy the user cancelled after it started (its engine ended: no listing) | Not copied. The folder <folder> may hold an unfinished copy. Check it before you delete anything. |

## Start (`app.platform.adapters.app_folder`)

| Key | Where it shows | Text |
|---|---|---|
| `msg:start.app_folder` | the sidecar cannot make its data folder or sync its parent at start (S0100, BL-0163 (a)); it exits before its handshake | Finzytrack cannot start: it could not set up its data folder <folder>/<app folder> (<system's answer>). Check that your user account may write in <folder>, then open Finzytrack again. |

## Error codes (`app.platform.errors.registry`)

The text a save shows for a code it has no own words for (`save_text.text`), and the API's message.

| Key | Where it shows | Text |
|---|---|---|
| `msg:code.WORKSPACE_NOT_OPEN` | `WORKSPACE_NOT_OPEN`: the registry's message and next step | **Message:** This workspace is not open. Finzytrack may have switched to another workspace in another window. **Next step:** Switch back to this workspace, or continue in the open one. |
| `msg:code.WORKSPACE_NOT_READY` | `WORKSPACE_NOT_READY`: the registry's message and next step | **Message:** This workspace is still getting ready. **Next step:** Wait a moment and try again. |
| `msg:code.ENGINE_QUEUE_FULL` | `ENGINE_QUEUE_FULL`: the registry's message and next step | **Message:** Finzytrack is busy with other ledger work. **Next step:** Please try again in a moment. |
| `msg:code.JOB_CANCELLED` | `JOB_CANCELLED`: the registry's message and next step | **Message:** Your request is cancelled. **Next step:** Start it again when you need it. |
| `msg:code.ENGINE_STOPPED` | `ENGINE_STOPPED`: the registry's message and next step | **Message:** The ledger engine stopped while working on this. **Next step:** Try again. If it happens again, copy the diagnostics and report a problem. |
| `msg:code.ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE` | `ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE`: the registry's message and next step | **Message:** The ledger engine is not working right now, so Finzytrack did not do this. **Next step:** Try again in a moment. If it happens again, copy the diagnostics and report a problem. |
| `msg:code.CHANGE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` | `CHANGE_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`: the registry's message and next step | **Message:** The ledger engine stopped while it was saving your change, so Finzytrack does not know yet whether it was saved. **Next step:** Do not make the change again until you have checked whether it is in your ledger. |
| `msg:code.LEDGER_EXTERNALLY_CHANGED` | `LEDGER_EXTERNALLY_CHANGED`: the registry's message and next step | **Message:** Your ledger changed after this preview, so Finzytrack did not save your change. **Next step:** Review it again. |
| `msg:code.LEDGER_CHANGING` | `LEDGER_CHANGING`: the registry's message and next step | **Message:** Your ledger kept changing while Finzytrack read it (another program, or one of the ledger's own plugins). **Next step:** Wait until it stops, then try again. |
| `msg:code.WRITES_PAUSED` | `WRITES_PAUSED`: the registry's message and next step | **Message:** Finzytrack could not finish saving a change, so saving is paused in this workspace. **Next step:** Reopen the workspace so Finzytrack can check your files. It undoes the unfinished change, or asks you about a file it was creating. |
| `msg:code.CHANGE_NOT_SAVED` | `CHANGE_NOT_SAVED`: the registry's message and next step | **Message:** Finzytrack did not save your change. **Next step:** Follow the steps shown, then try again. |
| `msg:code.INTERNAL` | `INTERNAL`: the registry's message and next step | **Message:** Something went wrong inside Finzytrack. **Next step:** Copy the diagnostics and report a problem. |
